# Body Belonging Clinic

> Body Belonging Clinic is a neurodivergent-led private therapy practice in Nedlands, Perth, Western Australia, with telehealth across Australia. It specialises in the overlap of ADHD and autism with eating disorders, disordered eating and body image. It is led by Lauren Lynch (she/her), an Accredited Mental Health Social Worker (AMHSW) and ANZAED Credentialed Eating Disorder Clinician who is ADHD herself.

Body Belonging Clinic provides therapy and support, not ADHD or autism assessment or diagnosis. It works alongside a client's GP, assessment service and wider care team. Care is affirming, anti-diet, LGBTQIA+ affirming and culturally aware. The campaign world is "Pull Up a Chair."

## Key facts

- Founder: Lauren Lynch (she/her), Accredited Mental Health Social Worker (AMHSW), member of the AASW, and ANZAED Credentialed Eating Disorder Clinician.
- Location: telehealth across Australia; in-person sessions in Nedlands, Perth, Western Australia (postcode 6009), on Whadjuk Noongar boodja.
- Specialty: where ADHD, autism and AuDHD meet eating, disordered eating, body image, ARFID and body distress. Also identity-, LGBTQIA+- and neurodivergent-affirming therapy.
- Who it helps: adults, young people and families navigating ADHD/autism and eating or body-image concerns; newly diagnosed ADHD adults; LGBTQIA+ people seeking affirming support; and referrers (GPs, dietitians, paediatricians, psychiatrists, ADHD assessment services, schools).
- Not provided: ADHD/autism assessment or diagnosis; therapy or diagnosis via Instagram or DMs; crisis or emergency care.
- Standard fee: $200 per 55-minute session. Medicare rebates may be available for eligible clients with a valid GP Mental Health Treatment Plan or an eligible Eating Disorder Treatment and Management Plan; out-of-pocket costs may apply.
- Eating Disorder Treatment and Management Plan (EDP): eligible clients may access up to 40 Medicare-rebated therapy sessions per year, plus up to 20 dietetic sessions.
- How to start: no referral is needed to book privately. Book online, or send a short enquiry. To access Medicare rebates, a GP plan or specialist referral is required.
- In partnership with ADHD WA.
- Contact: admin@bodybelongingclinic.com.au · phone 0493 117 185 · book at https://clientportal.zandahealth.com/clientportal/bodybelongingclinic/appointment-booking
- Crisis note: Body Belonging Clinic is not a crisis service. In an emergency call 000. For 24/7 support call Lifeline 13 11 14 or the Butterfly Foundation National Helpline 1800 33 4673.

## Services

- [ADHD & disordered eating therapy in Perth](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/adhd-disordered-eating-therapy-perth): where ADHD and eating meet, diagnosed, suspected or self-identified.
- [ADHD & neurodivergent support in Perth](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/adhd-neurodivergent-support-perth): affirming therapy for ADHD and neurodivergent adults and young people.
- [Autism, ARFID & eating therapy in Perth](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/autism-arfid-eating-therapy-perth): autism-affirming support for avoidant/restrictive eating and sensory needs.
- [Eating disorder & body image therapy in Perth](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/eating-disorder-body-image-therapy-perth): ANZAED-credentialed eating disorder and body-image therapy, including EDP pathways.
- [LGBTQIA+ affirming therapy in Perth](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/lgbtqia-affirming-therapy-perth): queer-led, identity-affirming support.
- [Referrals for GPs & clinicians](https://www.bodybelongingclinic.com.au/referrals): how to refer, Medicare and EDP pathways, and what the clinic holds.

## Common questions

- Do I need a diagnosis to start? No. The clinic works with people who are diagnosed, seeking assessment, or self-identifying. No proof is required.
- Do you diagnose ADHD or autism? No. Body Belonging provides therapy and support, not assessment or diagnosis, and works alongside your GP or assessment service.
- Can I use Medicare? Rebates may be available for eligible clients with a valid GP Mental Health Treatment Plan or an eligible Eating Disorder Treatment and Management Plan; out-of-pocket costs may apply.
- In person or online? Telehealth across Australia, with in-person sessions in Nedlands, Perth.
- Is it affirming? Yes. LGBTQIA+ and neurodivergent-affirming care is the starting point, not an add-on, and it is queer-led.
